title: Coached practice: compare evidence scopes

initial_facts.text: A settings update succeeds, but one reader sees the previous value.
A dashboard reports a normal overall cache hit rate.

public_evidence.text: The primary record has the updated setting.
public_evidence.source: Synthetic primary read for request S-8

public_evidence.text: Request S-8 returned a cached value.
The reader requests settings:user:8:rev3; invalidation removes settings:user:8.
The aggregate hit rate combines unrelated keys and says nothing about S-8's cached value.

coaching.lesson: Match each claim to evidence at the same scope. An aggregate rate cannot establish the value or key used by one request.
guided_steps: State the observation that needs explaining.
Ask which request-specific trace separates the live hypotheses.
Compare the source value, cache path, and exact reader/invalidation keys.
Name one regression case that would fail if the mismatch returned.

accepted_alternatives: Ask for request-level provenance before concluding.
Keep uncertainty if the exact key mapping is not yet available.
Use an exact-key assertion and a read-after-update regression check.
